title: rabbitgoo Calming Cat Beds for Indoor Cats, 20 inches, Dark Grey | Soft Warm Donut, Fluffy Faux Fur, Supportive Raised Rim, Anti-slip, Machine Washable, Up to 15lbs Kittens & Small Cats
features: Perfect Size Guide: This lightweight pet bed measures 20"x20"x5.7" for pets weighing up to 15 lbs. Ideal for kittens and small cats, such as Singapura, Devon Rex, and small Siamese, as well as puppies and toy-size dogs. If you are unsure about the size, we recommend choosing one size up for extra space and coziness

Restful Sleep Design: The rabbitgoo donut cat bed features a round shape with a raised rim for head and neck support. Its inviting, nest-like design creates a sense of security, encouraging pets to curl up naturally and drift into deep sleep

Ultra-Plush Comfort: Crafted from soft polyester plush fabric and high-resilience PP cotton, this cat bed offers a cloud-like, skin-safe feel for prolonged contact. Its generous filling provides ideal loft and elasticity, perfect for paw-kneading, napping, and stress relief

Fashionable & Durable：With a clean and contemporary design, this cat bed for indoor cats blends seamlessly into any home decor. Available in a range of stylish hues to suit personal tastes, it also features a sturdy non-slip rubber base that effectively prevents sliding and resists stains

Washable Cat Bed: No zippers, no hassle—just toss whole bed into your washing machine! It comes out looking fresh and fluffy every time. For best results, use a laundry bag on a cold gentle cycle, then tumble dry low. Gently fluff after drying to restore its soft, cozy loft
